text_block_list.text:
Summer camp. Твин Турбо is still running around 
and sweating as energetically as ever… but.

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haa…… Trainer! 
You are also smiling today! Alright!

She occasionally checks on 
me and repeats these words.

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you are smiling today too…!! 
Ehehe… haah, haah… haah, ehehe!!

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: Haah, haa, *cough* *cough*… haaa…

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's running… h-how was it…!! 
Am I sparkling… like Teio!?

Different from Токай Тэйо, it's still just a 
small light. But―

The sand that was kicked and fluttered look sparkling 
under the sunlight, as if giving off sparks.

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: …kuuuuu. Trainer, Turbo will! Turbo will also do it too.

Do what? Before I could ask her that Твин Турбо 
started running again.

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: Is there anything that makes you happy and excited!?

text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ A
text_block_list.text:
Eh, so suddenly like always… 
Ummm… It look like we will have curry tonight.

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
Not like that, something more fun! 
Something that make you go Uwaaaa! or Kyaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ A
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? Even if you suddenly ask me that… umm… ah. 
Oh right, earlier some local say there is firefly.

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: Firefly!? There is firefly!?

text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ A
text_block_list.text:
I heard. It's pretty deep in the mountain. 
I don't know the exact location.

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: Got it!! I'll go catch it!!

text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ A
text_block_list.text:
Eh!? Wait, Turbo!? 
You can't catch firefly… hey! Please wait!

―Before dinner. There is something I want to 
talk about tomorrow training… But Твин Турбо is 
nowhere to be seen.
When I was at a loss searching for her―

text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ A
text_block_list.text:
Umm! You are Твин Турбо's Trainer right? 
The truth is…!

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: Trainer…!!

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu～!! Trainerrrrrrr!! 
The firefly, I couldn't catch the firefly!

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haa… Where are you firefly…! 
If you think you can get away from Turbo… ah?

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
Woow…!! It's fireflies…! 
Amazing… amazing amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
Wait wait!! I'll show it to Trainer too!! Ugya!? 
Don't land on Turbo's nose! Eii, I'll catch you―

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
Ugya!? Uhhhhh!! Y-you're good…! 
But Turbo can still!!

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: Uuu-… *sniffle*.

Poor thing, but all thing considered 
nothing bad happen. I tell Turbo that 
she shouldn't catch the fireflies.

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
Is that so!? Did Turbo do a bad thing!? 
Uhhhh… ugh, *hiks* I'm sorry……

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: *hiks* *hiks*…… Turbo want to make Trainer smile…

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: Smiling uhhhhh……

While wiping the large tear spilling from her 
odd-eye with a handkerchief, I repeat Twin 
Turbo's word in my head.
"I want to make you smile"

That's why she still trying to catch it, even if 
she was covered in mud… that Твин Турбо.

Overwhelmed with emotion, I muttered these words 
and Твин Турбо looked at me with a puzzled expression.

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
*Sniffle*… you are happy even though you didn't 
see the firefly?
choice_data_list: Turbo's feeling make me very happy

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
Eh… ah, y-yeah! You know, they look like stars! 
And then they flew around a lot, and then, and then…

Твин Турбо talk excitedly. 
Looking at her happily talking, I realized that…

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: … Trainer, why are you smiling again?

I laugh again when I see Твин Турбо making 
puzzled face while looking at me.
choice_data_list: I'm happy when Turbo is happy.

text_block_list.text:
If Твин Турбо is happy I'm also happy, if she is having fun 
I'm also having fun. I will also feel her Sorrow and suffering too.

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
…Turbo is also the same!! 
If Trainer is happy, Turbo is happy too!!

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: Trainer and Turbo are the same!!

Before I can say yes, 
2 fireflies fly from the back of Turbo's clothes.

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? T-Trainer! It's fireflies! look look! 
I-I didn't catch it! It just stay on my clothes!!

It's only 2 faint lights, but they were brighter 
than the starry sky.

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text: Thank you fireflies!!

Твин Турбо waving at the fireflies, 
and then she look at me who is still smiling.
choice_data_list: Let's see even more light next раз

text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо
text_block_list.text:
…! Yes, let's do it!! 
And then the two of us will be happy again.

I laughed as if I was drawn to the smile of Твин Турбо. 
The two fireflies flew far away into the mountains.
